issues.issue: First-edition printed chapter XCVI corresponds to stable editorial sequential XCVII due an earlier duplicate number.
The subject is a woman's imprisoned husband; do not combine her horoscope, husband, or military background with the earlier escaped prisoner.
Original chart at PDF505/printed471 appears dated October 19, 1645 7:20 PM, but exact Old Style calendrical framing requires independent verification.
The author simultaneously allows the husband ALREADY to be free or alternatively to be released in the following three days; this disjunction weakens prospectively falsifiable specificity.
Lilly later reports liberation AND capture of the garrison occurred the day BEFORE the question. These events were in the past relative to the chart, not prospective predictions.
Whether Lilly personally already knew of the garrison capture or release at the time of the question is unknown and cannot be inferred from his retrospective statement.
None of the woman's original inquiry, the husband's name, prison, garrison, correspondent or Parliament commander is independently identified.
A claimed release, garrison capture, money transfer and other supplies are separate event endpoints, and not independently confirmed.
The references to 'Majesty' and a Parliament colonel take place in a contested Civil-War political setting and should not be converted to partisan evaluation.
Jupiter as seventh ruler signifies husband, while the Moon, Sun and Saturn represent different timing/house testimony, not observed behavior.
Jupiter in Cancer retrograde, trine Sun, Moon sextile Saturn then trine Jupiter and reception should be independently calculated before any claim of correct chart parity.
'Lately, or the day before' is a source ambiguity in aspect timing, not an externally dated observation.
The author infers short incarceration from Jupiter's exaltation, retrogradation, cardinal sign and trine to Sun fourth lord, but supplies no verified custody duration.
The 'Solar man/Commander' is an astrological conjecture and the Parliament colonel is an author-reported matching actor with no independent records.
No complete blind, contemporaneous, timestamped forecast and outcome freeze is supplied, nor any verified external release record.
Original source page 506 has a horizontal line after the conclusion and begins 'A Table'; the book thereafter contains unnumbered material, which must not be dropped.
Original PDF507/printed continuation includes a separate unnumbered May 1644 Essex chart; PDF508 onward contains tabular material requiring coverage before source completion.
Navigation to the postchapter table and Earl of Essex example is not proof that there is a next numbered Chapter XCVII or XCVIII in the printing.
No newly validated astrology forecast, medical/legal fact, independent political event, or runtime scoring/model promotion follows from documentary extraction.
